description: This file defines the class RetrieveFeaturesResponse, which represents the response to a RetrieveFeatures command in an IoT or device management context. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing retrieved feature data, and serializing the response to JSON.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesResponse
classes.description: Response class for handling the result of retrieving features from a thing, providing JSON serialization/deserialization, accessors, and equality/hashCode implementations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of RetrieveFeaturesResponse from various inputs (thing ID as String or ThingId, JSON object/string, or features object).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeaturesResponse instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the Features object that was retrieved.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the features to a JSON object based on the schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the entity set to the provided JSON value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource represented.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload data to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality check, confirming type compatibility.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on thing ID, features, and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on superclass, thing ID, and features.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
